request_outcomes.question: How early should I arrive?
request_outcomes.answer: If it is your first visit to our clinic, please arrive 15 minutes before your appointment time to complete your registration paperwork. Returning patients can arrive 5 to 10 minutes prior to their slot.

assistant_message.content:
Thanks for reaching out! Here's what I can tell you:

If this is your first visit to our clinic, please plan to arrive 15 minutes early to complete your registration paperwork. If you're a returning patient, arriving 5 to 10 minutes before your scheduled time is sufficient.

As for your question about whether the waiting room has Wi-Fi available, I don't have that information in the clinic's knowledge base. I've forwarded this question to our staff, who will follow up with you. In the meantime, feel free to ask if there's anything else I can help with.
